title: Attaining Doppler precision of 3 m/s
what_was_studied: Iodine-cell forward modelling of wavelength scale and spectrometer profile
numerical_result: The method demonstrated approximately 3 m/s precision in its tested observations
remaining_question: Instrument-specific transfer to UCLES requires its own era and target evidence

title: Availability of an iodine cell for precision velocity measurements
what_was_studied: UCLES iodine hardware and placement in the telescope beam
numerical_result: The 10 cm by 5 cm Pyrex cell became available from semester 1998B
remaining_question: A hardware capability is not an achieved long-term stellar floor

title: First results from the Anglo-Australian Planet Search
what_was_studied: The first 2.5 years of UCLES iodine observations for about 200 solar-type stars
numerical_result: The paper reports a demonstrated limiting Doppler precision of 3 m/s in its early survey data
remaining_question: Detector, template and observing-era offsets need row-level treatment

title: Observing with UCLES
what_was_studied: Instrument configuration, resolving power and iodine observing instructions
numerical_result: The archived guide states resolving power of at least 40000 depending on slit width
remaining_question: The page is under decommissioned instruments and does not give a precise retirement date
